notes: A bugfix release for publishing. SFTP uploaded files writable by every account on the server; 1.1.1 uploads with 0644 and fixes earlier uploads once per target. SFTP and FTP paths starting with "~" now mean the login folder, rsync refuses shell characters in the remote path, and a folder target stops when its folder is missing. Answer "Always Allow" when macOS asks about the Keychain after updating.
